title: Senior Product Manager - User and Lifecycle Analytics
description_clean:
Contentsquare is the all-in-one experience intelligence platform designed to be easily used by anyone who cares about digital journeys. With our flexible and scalable platform, organizations quickly get a deep understanding of their customers’ whole online journey.
 
We are a global leader in the experience analytics space, with a growing presence across 15 offices worldwide. We’re here to stay—and we’re looking for team members who are excited to drive impact and help us scale even further.
 
Our aim is to create an inclusive workplace where everyone learns and succeeds. Contentsquare has built a community of individuals who are daring, understanding, and deliberate. We invite you to join us in making the complex simpler—for our customers, their customers, and each other.
 
Important note: Be careful of scammers pretending to be from Contentsquare. We will never ask for money or contact you through random texts. Any communication from our in house Talent Acquisition team will only ever come from our contentsquare.com or ----- domain. For more information, visit our careers blog.The role
We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to help customers understand how different groups of users behave over time: who converts, who comes back, who becomes more engaged, and who may be starting to drop away.
You will lead the product strategy for user segmentation and lifecycle analytics. The work sits between product analytics and marketing technology. You will help customers define meaningful audiences, compare their behavior, understand what drives conversion and retention, and use those insights within Contentsquare and third party tools and platforms.
You will work closely with Engineering and Product Design, along with data, identity, AI, and other product teams. Some of the experiences you lead will depend on shared data and analytics services, so the role requires both clear product judgment and the ability to work collaboratively across different domains.
The immediate priorities are:


Segmentation and filtering: Make it easier for customers to define, save, compare, and reuse audiences across their analyses.


User and retention analysis: Help customers move from aggregate trends to cohorts and individual users, compare behavior over time, and identify what contributes to conversion, engagement, and retention.


Future lifecycle intelligence: Explore opportunities such as lifecycle stages, engagement scoring, automatic segment suggestions, and predictions related to conversion, retention, or churn.


What you will do 
Set Product Direction


Define the product strategy, roadmap, and success measures for user segmentation and lifecycle analytics.


Decide which customer problems to prioritize, balancing customer value, product quality, technical constraints, and business goals.


Make clear trade-offs about what the team will and will not build.


Communicate product choices to executives, partner teams, and customer-facing teams.


Understand Customers and the Market


Work directly with customers to understand how product, marketing, ecommerce, and customer experience teams analyze user behavior.


Use customer research, product data, field feedback, and market evidence to guide priorities.


Follow developments in product analytics, customer data, and marketing technology, including how other products approach segmentation, cohorts, retention, and activation.


Partner with Design and Engineering to test ideas before making larger investments.


Build Better Segmentation and Lifecycle Analysis


Improve how customers define, manage, compare, and reuse user segments.


Make filtering easier to understand and more consistent across relevant product workflows.


Help customers move from a chart, funnel, or retention cohort to the users behind the result without rebuilding the same audience in several places.


Develop user-level and retention analysis that helps customers identify changes in behavior and the experiences associated with stronger or weaker outcomes.


Explore Predictive Intelligence


Investigate opportunities such as lifecycle classification, engagement scoring, automatic segmentation, and predictions related to conversion, retention, or churn.


Partner with Data and Applied AI teams to evaluate data readiness, feasibility, accuracy, explainability, cost, and customer trust.


Validate that customers can understand and act on predictive insights before adding them to the roadmap.


Lead Across Teams


Work with Engineering and Product Design from problem definition through launch and iteration.


Partner with data, platform, identity, and other product teams when shared capabilities are needed.


Define product KPIs and track adoption, usefulness, quality, performance, and customer value.


Build strong relationships with Customer Success, Sales, Product Marketing, and other go-to-market teams.


Use product performance and customer feedback to adjust priorities after launch.


What you will need to succeed


5+ years of product management experience in B2B software or another complex data product, with responsibility for strategy, roadmap, and measurable outcomes.


Experience in product analytics, customer data, audience platforms, marketing technology, lifecycle and retention products, experimentation, or a closely related area.


A practical understanding of segmentation, funnels, cohorts, conversion, engagement, and retention analysis.


Strong customer discovery skills and experience using qualitative feedback and product data together to make decisions.


Experience working with Engineering and Product Design on products that rely on shared data, APIs, identity, or analytics services.


Enough technical depth to discuss data quality, semantics, performance, and architectural trade-offs with engineers.


Strong communication and prioritization skills, including the ability to lead across distributed teams without direct authority.


What Makes you stand out 


Experience spanning both product analytics and marketing technology.


Work on audience builders, customer data platforms, personalization, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation products.


Experience building retention, cohort, or user-level analytics.


Familiarity with event-based data, user identity, cross-device behavior, or high-volume analytical queries.


Experience developing predictive, recommendation, or machine-learning-assisted product experiences.


Why you should join Contentsquare
We invest in our people through career development, mentorship, social events, philanthropic activities, and competitive benefits. We are always assessing the perks we offer to ensure we’re aligned with the employees' needs.
 
Here are a few we want to highlight:
- Virtual onboarding, Hackathon, and various opportunities to interact with your team and global colleagues both on and offsite each year
- Work flexibility: hybrid and remote work policies
- Generous paid time-off policy (every location is different)
- Lifestyle allowance
- A Culture Crew in every country we’re based in to coordinate regular activities for employees to get to know each other and bond outside of work
- Every full-time employee receives stock options, allowing them to share in the company’s success
- We have multiple Employee Resource Groups, that offer a safe space for individuals who share common identities, life experiences, or allyship to connect, support one another, and passionately advocate for the issues close to their hearts
- And more benefits tailored to each country

As an iOS Engineer on the Design System team, you'll translate SumUp's design language into a reusable, easy-to-use library of UI components and experience patterns — empowering product teams to build cohesive, accessible user experiences at scale.

Bring 3+ years of professional iOS development experience, ideally on large-scale or consumer-facing applications

Bring a strong grasp of testing best practices for UI components, including unit tests, snapshot tests, and UI automation
Are comfortable reviewing code and mentoring peers — you enjoy sharing knowledge, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team
Are self-motivated and structured in your working style — you manage your own priorities, communicate clearly in English, and thrive in a cross-functional, collaborative environment
Stay genuinely curious about the iOS ecosystem — you follow Apple's releases closely, experiment with new APIs, and are excited to bring fresh ideas back to the team

🌎 Opportunity to work with SumUppers globally on large-scale fintech products used by millions of businesses worldwide, from our Berlin office. This involves an office-first setup

title: AI Field Engineer
description_clean:
About CHAPTERS Group
CHAPTERS Group AG is a Hamburg-based holding company investing in 55+ mission-critical software companies across the DACH region, France, and the Czech Republic. Our companies deliver the digital solutions that keep the public sector and core industries running. What they do matters in daily life.
AI has rapidly disrupted the software industry, and we aim to lead that transformation across our portfolio. Central to this is the AI Core team: we build and operate a shared enterprise AI Hub used by companies across the group, and drive adoption through a network of AI Champions. Each portfolio company has one designated power user who leads AI enablement locally, runs training, and scales usage within their organisation.
Tasks
The Role
You are part of the AI Core team but your work extends beyond it. Most of your time is spent embedded within one of our portfolio groups: responsible for deploying and operating the AI Hub for the companies within that group and integrating AI into their real business processes. Beyond this, you support the M&A team to develop AI driven use cases to support our acquisition strategy. You build production-grade systems, connect AI capabilities to existing infrastructure and make sure what gets deployed actually runs stably in the long term. You step in when complex AI use cases require real engineering work and changes to the companies cloud infrastructure.
What You Will Work On

Design and deploy production-grade AI solutions integrated into real operational systems: ERP, accounting tools, email inboxes, and legacy workflows
Build, test, and maintain integrations with enterprise services including MCP servers, Microsoft Graph, Git/Bitbucket, and REST APIs
You understand that shipping a solution is just the beginning. Your designs gather signals and feedback from operations for a continuous improvement cycle. Ensure AI systems run with full observability: logging, alerting, and audit trails that let non-technical stakeholders understand what is happening.
Work closely with AI Champions and portfolio group teams to translate business needs into implementable AI solutions and enable the Champions with your technical expertise to implement more use cases without your help in the future
Deploy, configure, and operate AI Hub instances (Open WebUI) for the portfolio companies within your assigned portfolio group: including onboarding, custom model setup, tool integrations, SSO, and ongoing maintenance
Support the M&A team to identify new targets, automate outreach and, support Due Diligence of new acquisition targets

Requirements
What We Are Looking For
Required

At least 2 years of professional experience in a DevOps, backend engineering, or platform engineering role
Python fluency: you write clean, maintainable code and are comfortable owning a codebase
Practical experience with cloud infrastructure & production deployments on Azure, AWS, or GCP
Solid familiarity with Docker, REST APIs, Git, and CI/CD deployment workflows: including deploying and configuring containerised applications for end-customer environments
AI-native: you work with LLMs, know their limits, and have shipped something real using them
Strong communication skills: you translate technical decisions into business language and can work effectively with non-technical stakeholders
German (native or C2) and English (fluent): both are used daily across teams and OpCos

Bonus

Experience integrating AI into ERP, CRM, or accounting systems
Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks and tool-calling patterns
Infrastructure as Code experience (Bicep, Terraform, or CloudFormation)
Experience with enterprise authentication and identity (OAuth, SSO, Azure AD / Entra ID)
Prior experience working across multiple companies or in a group / holding structure

Benefits
What You'll Get

A dual role with real variety: strategic platform work at group level combined with hands-on implementation inside a Portfolio Platform
Become part of CHAPTERS Group, a German serial acquirer with 10x growth in the past five years and high ambitions for what comes next
A small, high-ownership team: decisions get made fast, your work ships to production. You are part of the CTO office with a direct line to the leadership team
Daily work with cutting-edge AI technologies
Space to define how AI gets integrated into operational business systems at group scale: early-stage work with lasting impact across 55+ companies
Permanent full-time position, remote-first with regular on-site time
A clear path to grow with us: we look for ambitious people who want to build a career, not just take a role. We actively invest in your development: talent reviews, events, conferences, etc.

How to Apply
Send your CV and answer the following questions, no formal cover letter needed:

Why do you find it exciting to work with vertical market software companies?
Why are you the right person to drive AI in the CHAPTERS Group? What is your “unfair advantage”?

We are looking forward to your application!

Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder Weiterbildung, beispielsweise als Elektroniker für Automatisierungstechnik, Mechatroniker oder Techniker und bringst praktische Erfahrung im industriellen Umfeld mit.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (Python/Django + Vue.js)
description_clean:
Important: You must be based in Berlin for this role. We offer flexibility to work from home, but this is not a remote-from-anywhere position.
Hivebuy is a Berlin-based B2B procurement SaaS transforming how companies manage purchasing, approvals, orders, invoices, budgets and suppliers.
We’re building much more than a CRUD application. Our platform combines complex procurement workflows, multi-tenant architecture, ERP and accounting integrations, real-time functionality and increasingly AI-powered workflows.
We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with a strong backend focus to help us build and evolve this platform.
We’re looking for a T-shaped engineer: someone with deep backend expertise who is also comfortable following a feature across the entire stack. You don’t need to be equally strong in Django and Vue, but you should be willing and able to understand, change and ship both.
Our core stack includes Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Elasticsearch, Vue 3, TypeScript and AWS. We run our services on ECS Fargate, manage infrastructure with Terraform, and use Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry and CloudWatch to understand what’s happening in production.
AI coding agents are a normal part of how we develop software. We believe they make strong engineers significantly more effective, but they also make judgment, verification and ownership more important, not less.
Tasks

Own features end-to-end. Understand the problem, challenge requirements when necessary, design the solution, implement it, test it, deploy it and verify that it actually works in production.
Design and build backend services and APIs using Python, Django and Django REST Framework.
Work with PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery and Elasticsearch to build reliable, scalable application and background-processing workflows.
Work across the stack when necessary, implementing and debugging functionality in our Vue 3 + TypeScriptfrontend.
Build and maintain integrations with external systems such as ERP/accounting platforms, authentication providers, billing systems, Slack and Microsoft Teams.
Work on our growing AI-powered product features and help us integrate LLMs responsibly into production workflows.
Investigate production issues across the complete system, from browser to API, background workers, databases and infrastructure.
Write meaningful automated tests using tools such as pytest, Vitest and Playwright.
Improve performance, reliability, monitoring and deployment safety.
Participate in architecture discussions and make technical decisions that keep the system maintainable as we grow.
Review code and help maintain a high engineering standard across the team.
Identify technical improvements proactively. If you see a bad pattern, flaky test, slow endpoint, missing metric or repetitive manual process, we expect you to improve it or make it visible.
Use AI coding agents as part of your engineering workflow for implementation, investigation, testing, review and understanding unfamiliar parts of the system.
Communicate proactively in our distributed working environment, document important decisions and surface blockers and risks early.

For us, “done” does not mean “PR merged.” Done means the change is running in production, works as intended and has been verified.
Requirements

Strong professional experience building and operating production systems with Python and Django, ideally Django REST Framework.
Deep understanding of PostgreSQL, including data modelling, migrations, query performance, indexing and diagnosing database-related production issues.
Experience designing and evolving asynchronous and distributed workloads, ideally with Celery and Redis, including retries, idempotency, failure handling and long-running tasks.
Strong understanding of software architecture and system design. You can make pragmatic architectural decisions, explain the trade-offs and evolve existing systems without unnecessary rewrites.
Experience owning features and systems from design through production, including deployment, monitoring, verification and incident investigation.
Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD workflows and deployment strategies, ideally including chunk-based or independently deployable components, safe rollouts, automated quality gates and rollback strategies.
Strong experience with production observability. You know how to use metrics, logs, error tracking and profiling to understand system behaviour and find root causes instead of guessing.
Experience identifying and solving performance and scalability problems across applications, databases, background workers and infrastructure.
Experience working with AWS or comparable cloud infrastructure and a good understanding of how applications actually run in production.
Enough Vue/TypeScript or comparable frontend experience to own a feature across the full stack, investigate frontend problems and ship frontend changes without depending on another engineer for every UI task.
Experience designing and maintaining external integrations, including failure handling, authentication, webhooks and third-party API behaviour.
Strong engineering judgment. You can distinguish between something that needs architectural work, something that needs a small pragmatic fix and something that should not be built at all.
You proactively identify technical problems and improvements instead of waiting for them to become tickets.
You are comfortable challenging requirements, existing architecture and technical decisions when you have a better approach, and can communicate the reasoning clearly.
You use AI coding agents as engineering tools, not just code generators, and remain fully responsible for understanding, reviewing, testing and operating what you ship.
You are currently based in Berlin or are willing to relocate to Berlin.

Benefits

Flexible hybrid work with the freedom to work from home while being part of our Berlin-based team.
An office in the heart of Berlin with drinks, snacks and communal lunches.
Trust-based working hours. We care about outcomes rather than tracking hours.
A high degree of technical ownership and autonomy.
Direct influence on architecture, engineering practices and how our technology evolves.
AI-native engineering workflows. Modern coding agents are tools we actively expect and encourage you to use.
A modern production stack across backend, frontend, infrastructure and observability.
Flat hierarchies and short communication paths.
The opportunity to shape engineering practices while our team and product grow.
Urban Sports Club membership options.
BVG Ticket
JOB Bicycle

We’re not looking for someone whose primary value is simply writing code quickly.
AI has changed that part of software development.
What matters to us is whether you can understand a problem, make good technical decisions, challenge assumptions, use the tools available to you, verify the result and take responsibility for what happens in production.
You don’t need to know every part of our stack. You do need to be curious enough to investigate what you don’t know and comfortable taking ownership beyond the boundaries of a ticket.
We also know our existing codebase isn’t perfect. We don’t expect you to blindly copy existing patterns just because they’re already there. When you find something that can be better, we want you to say so and help us improve it.
If that’s how you like to work, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Backend Engineer (m/w/d) - Founding Team
description_clean:
About Zahln
Zahln, by Zysygy, is building Germany's zero-fee payment network. Merchants pay zero transaction fees. We route payments directly over SEPA Instant, bypassing Visa, Mastercard, and the entire card network chain. No hardware. No card reader. Just a phone. We are building the first company to combine a fully software-based merchant POS with a consumer super-app for everyday financial life: payments, transport, utilities, government services, all in one place. Think what UPI did for India. We are doing it for Germany, from the ground up, on banking rails.:
EXIST Funding
This role is open to Master's and PhD students or recent graduates (within 5 years) from German universities, eligible for EXIST Gründerstipendium funding.
Location
Remote within Germany. Open to students at any German university eligible for EXIST Gründerstipendium.
Language
English is the working language of the team. German is a plus but not required.
Tasks
**Role Overview
**You will join the core engineering team as a founding engineer. You will own the backend payment engine end to end: transaction flows, wallet management, SEPA Instant settlement, KYB/KYC integration, recurring mandates, refund logic, and the compliance export layer (DATEV, Kassenbuch, GoBD, fiskaltrust). On mobile, you will contribute to the React Native consumer and merchant apps alongside our mobile engineer. You will own what you build from development through deployment, monitoring, and production reliability. The architecture decisions you make in the first six months will run in production for years.
What you will do

Design and build the backend payment engine: transaction flows, wallet management, SEPA Instant settlement, offline payment authorization, and recurring mandate billing.
Own KYB/KYC integration and the compliance export layer: DATEV, Kassenbuch, GoBD, and fiskaltrust for KassenSichV.
Build REST APIs for financial-grade reliability and high-throughput transaction processing, including full R-transaction handling and reconciliation pipelines.
Contribute to the React Native consumer and merchant mobile apps alongside our mobile engineer.
Own the full lifecycle of what you build, from development through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
Integrate AI tooling into your development workflow as a matter of course: code generation, automated testing, and intelligent review.

Requirements
Who you are

Currently enrolled in a Master's or PhD program at a German university, or recently graduated within the last 5 years.
Solid backend engineering foundation. You have built systems that handle real data, you understand databases, APIs, and what happens when things fail.
You think carefully about data consistency and reliability. You have had to ask yourself what happens if this fails halfway through and actually worked out the answer.
You take ownership of what you build end-to-end, from writing the code to making sure it runs in production.
You can explain technical decisions clearly to people who are not engineers.
Comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage risk. There is no playbook yet. You will help write it.
Our stack includes Go, Node.js, Python, React Native, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs over SEPA Instant rails. Experience with any of these is a plus. What matters more is that you pick up new tools fast and care about writing reliable, maintainable code.

Strong Bonus (not required)

If any of the following apply to you, you will hit the ground running faster than most:
You have meaningful hands-on experience building payment systems, fintech infrastructure, or financial APIs.
You have designed a ledger and understand double-entry bookkeeping, immutable transaction records, and why you never update a financial row.
You have solved the partial failure problem. Money left one wallet and did not arrive in the other. You know how to detect it, resolve it, and prevent it.
You understand idempotency at a design level. Your systems survive client retries, duplicate webhooks, and network drops without double-charging anyone.
You have built or reasoned about reconciliation: detecting discrepancies between your internal ledger and an external settlement file and resolving them reliably at scale.
You understand KYC and KYB state machines and what a regulator expects from your audit trail.

Benefits
Benefits

Be part of a founding team eligible for EXIST Gründerstipendium, a grant from the German government that funds you to build.
Flexible hours and fully remote within Germany.
Early-stage means something here. Small team, real ownership, no queue of 40 PRs ahead of yours.
The problems are genuinely hard. Distributed systems, financial consistency, payment rails, real money moving in real time. If you want to spend your next two years solving problems that actually require you to think, this is the right place.
The systems you build will not be thrown away after a demo. They will run in production, handle real transactions, and be used by real people. Your fingerprints stay on it.
You will work with people who left stable paths to build a faster, simpler way to move money in Germany. Less bureaucracy, more momentum. If that sounds like your kind of problem, you will fit right in.
